summaries.en: Meetily is a privacy-first AI meeting assistant that runs 100% locally, eliminating cloud dependency for sensitive conversations. Built on Rust, it leverages a 4x faster Parakeet/Whisper pipeline for live transcription and speaker diarization, with Ollama-powered summarization. This design ensures both speed and confidentiality. You can run it on macOS or Windows: simply install, point it to a meeting audio source, and receive real-time transcripts and concise summaries—ideal for remote teams, journalists, or anyone prioritizing data privacy.
summaries.zh: Meetily是一款本地运行的AI会议助手，采用Rust构建高性能管道，整合比标准Whisper快4倍的Parakeet模型实现实时语音转写，并支持说话人分离，最后通过Ollama本地模型生成会议摘要。在macOS或Windows上安装后，导入或录制会议音频即可获取带说话人标签的文字记录和精炼摘要。该工具无需云端处理，从源头杜绝数据外泄，特别适合对隐私敏感的远程团队、记者及法律从业者在离线环境中高效整理会议内容。

summaries.en: Unity MCP bridges AI assistants with the Unity editor via the Model Context Protocol, enabling LLMs to manage assets, control scenes, edit scripts, and automate workflows. Its key strength lies in standardizing AI-Editor interactions through MCP, making integrations extensible and robust. Developers can connect tools like Claude or Gemini to Unity, automate repetitive tasks, or build intelligent game design assistants that understand context.
summaries.zh: Unity MCP 通过模型上下文协议（MCP）在 AI 助手与 Unity 编辑器之间搭建桥梁，让大语言模型能够管理资源、控制场景、编辑脚本并自动化工作流。其核心设计是利用 MCP 标准化 AI 与编辑器的交互，使集成更可扩展且健壮。技术亮点在于将 Unity 的脚本 API 封装为 MCP 工具，LLM 无需理解引擎细节即可调用。游戏开发者可接入 Claude、Gemini 等助手，自动执行批量材质替换、场景布局调整等重复任务，或构建理解上下文、辅助关卡设计的智能工具。

summaries.en: Romm is a self-hosted ROM manager and player that simplifies organizing and playing retro game collections. Its key technical insight is automatic metadata scraping and artwork fetching, combined with a web-based interface that launches games directly in the browser via integrated emulators. You can self-host it with Docker, import your ROM files, and instantly enjoy a unified, searchable library with built-in emulation—perfect for preserving and accessing classic games.
summaries.zh: Romm 是一款自托管复古游戏 ROM 管理器和播放器，旨在解决游戏收藏混乱和无法统一播放的问题。它通过自动刮削元数据和封面图，让用户可以在美观的 Web 界面中浏览和启动游戏。其技术亮点是集成了基于浏览器的模拟器，无需额外配置即可直接运行。你可以利用 Docker 快速部署，导入 ROM 文件后即可拥有一个自带模拟功能的统一游戏库，非常适合复古游戏爱好者和收藏家。

summaries.en: Terax-ai is a lightweight (7MB) terminal-first AI-native development workspace that embeds intelligent agents directly into the command line, solving the problem of constant context switching between coding and AI assistants. Technically, it leverages Tauri for a native shell experience and a React-based UI inside the terminal (via Xterm.js), allowing AI agents to observe commands, output, and errors in real time to provide contextual suggestions and automations. Practically, developers can replace their existing terminal with Terax-ai to gain AI-powered autocomplete, error explanations, and the ability to create custom agent plugins for repetitive tasks.
summaries.zh: Terax-ai 是一个仅7MB的终端优先AI原生开发工作台，将智能代理嵌入命令行，解决开发者频繁切换IDE和AI工具的效率问题。其技术亮点在于使用Tauri构建原生终端外壳，结合Xterm.js和React UI，使AI代理能实时感知命令执行过程，提供上下文相关的建议或自动完成重复任务。你可以直接替换现有终端，体验AI辅助的自动补全、命令解释和错误调试，或通过自定义插件扩展代理能力，实现个性化工作流自动化。

summaries.en: Folia-major is a web-based music player that focuses on stunning lyric animations, supporting local files, Navidrome servers, and Netease Cloud Music as sources. Technically, it leverages React and TypeScript with a PWA architecture, enabling smooth offline playback and responsive design. Developers can deploy it instantly on Vercel, or fork and customize the animation system using CSS keyframes. For music enthusiasts, it offers a visually immersive experience that transforms passive listening into an engaging spectacle.

summaries.en: A curated collection of project-based tutorials that teach programming by building real-world applications, solving the problem of abstract learning. Unlike passive lectures, these guides emphasize hands-on construction, covering languages like Python, JavaScript, Go, and C++. Learners progress from simple toys to complex systems, gaining practical skills. Developers can choose a project matching their level, follow clear steps, and deploy results, making it ideal for self-taught programmers and bootcamp students seeking portfolio projects.

summaries.en: This is an FP8 quantized version of Google's Gemma-4 31B instruction-tuned model, designed to reduce memory footprint and latency for large-scale inference while preserving output quality. Using block-wise FP8 quantization via llm-compressor, it roughly halves model size and supports efficient serving with vLLM. Ideal for chatbots, visual Q&A, and real-time applications, you can load it directly with vLLM or Hugging Face transformers for production deployment.
summaries.zh: 这是 Google Gemma-4 31B 指令微调模型的 FP8 量化版本，目标是在保持生成质量的前提下大幅降低大模型推理的内存占用和延迟。通过 llm-compressor 的块状 FP8 量化技术，模型体积减半，配合 vLLM 等推理引擎可实现高效部署。适用于对话机器人、图文问答等实时场景，开发者可直接用 vLLM 或 transformers 加载，快速投入生产使用。

summaries.en: wav2vec2-base is a self-supervised speech representation model from Meta AI that learns powerful audio features from unlabeled data, drastically reducing the need for transcribed speech. Its key innovation is contrastive learning with quantized target representations, enabling the model to capture phonetic units without supervision. You can fine-tune it on as little as 10 minutes of labeled speech for competitive automatic speech recognition, or extract general-purpose features for tasks like speaker verification or emotion recognition.
summaries.zh: wav2vec2-base 是 Meta AI 推出的自监督语音表示模型，通过从无标签音频中学习通用语音特征，大幅降低了对人工标注转录的需求。其核心技术是使用对比学习与量化目标表示，让模型在无监督条件下自动捕捉音素级语言单元。实际应用中，你只需少量标注数据（如10分钟）微调，即可获得媲美全监督方案的语音识别性能；也可将其作为通用特征提取器，用于说话人验证、情感分析等下游任务。借助 Hugging Face Transformers 库，一行代码即可加载预训练权重并快速上手。

summaries.en: Gemma-4-12B-it is a 12B parameter instruction-tuned multimodal model that handles text and image inputs, excelling in vision-language tasks. Its unified any-to-any architecture seamlessly integrates multiple modalities, enabling efficient cross-modal reasoning. Deploy it for chatbots, visual Q&A, or content creation—it runs on consumer GPUs thanks to distillation techniques.
summaries.zh: Gemma-4-12B-it 是谷歌推出的120亿参数指令微调多模态模型，支持文本与图像输入，在视觉语言任务中表现突出。其统一“任意到任意”架构实现多模态无缝融合，通过蒸馏技术保持高效推理与低资源占用。开发者可将其用于聊天机器人、视觉问答或内容生成，无需高端硬件即可体验强大的多模态能力。
